tiers.name: Close Circle
tiers.tagline: The people who would have come anyway
tiers.description: Home, terrace or a small hall. Everything cooked fresh, set up before your guests arrive, cleared after they leave.
tiers.coordination: A coordinator on WhatsApp, from booking to the day itself
highlights: Cooked and served at your home or hall
Simple, well-finished decor at the entrance and the main table
One coordinator you can message any time

tiers.name: House Full
tiers.tagline: Everyone who matters, and the house is full
tiers.description: The clubhouse or a small hall, a proper buffet, and a setup that photographs well without taking over the room.
tiers.coordination: A coordinator on WhatsApp, plus a call the evening before
highlights: Buffet counters with serving staff
Entrance, stage backdrop and table styling
Crockery, seating and clearing included

tiers.name: The Full Celebration
tiers.description: A hall, a real stage, a menu with choices on it, and photographs you will actually print. The middle of the ladder, and the middle for a reason.
tiers.coordination: A named coordinator, venue visit included, reachable on call
highlights: Styled stage, entrance arch and guest tables
Live counter of your choice
Photography through the main hours
Venue visit before the day

tiers.name: Special Day
tiers.tagline: A day the whole family travels for
tiers.description: Full hall, full menu, someone from Sambramo standing in the room all day so that nobody in your family has to be the one chasing the decorator.
tiers.coordination: A named coordinator plus an on-site manager for the full day
highlights: On-site manager from setup to clearing
Two live counters
Photography and video coverage
Guest seating, lighting and sound

tiers.name: Grand
tiers.tagline: The one people talk about afterwards
tiers.description: A production. Staged lighting, a designed backdrop, multiple counters, and a crew that arrives the night before.
tiers.coordination: A coordinator, an on-site manager and a setup crew from the night before
highlights: Designed stage with lighting and truss
Three live counters and a dessert station
Full photo and cinematic video team
Guest transport and parking coordination

tiers.name: Arasu Vaibhava
tiers.description: The full traditional spread on banana leaf, a marquee, and a team large enough that six hundred guests are seated and served without a queue forming.
tiers.coordination: A dedicated team: lead coordinator, floor managers, and a crew on site for three days
highlights: Marquee, stage and full floral installation
Banana-leaf service with a serving team per section
Four or more live counters
Multi-camera video, drone and same-day edit
Guest hospitality desk and transport

tiers.name: The Grand Assembly
tiers.tagline: A whole community, seated and served
tiers.description: Convention scale. Multiple serving lines running at once, a marquee big enough that nobody eats standing, and a crew sized so two thousand people are through dinner without a queue forming.
tiers.coordination: A lead coordinator, section managers and a standing crew on site for the full setup, event and teardown
highlights: Multiple parallel serving lines, so no queue forms
Marquee, stage and full floral installation
Five or more live counters
Crowd flow, parking and guest hospitality planned in advance
Multi-camera video with a same-day edit

tiers.name: Sea of People
tiers.tagline: The scale where logistics is the event
tiers.description: Past a certain size the food is the easy part. This is a planned operation: staggered seating, its own water and power, a medical point, and a control desk that knows where every one of your guests is meant to be.
tiers.coordination: A full operations team: event director, section leads, a control desk and crew across every shift
highlights: Staggered seating in batches, so nobody waits standing
Independent water, power backup and a medical point
Six or more live counters with dedicated replenishment
Parking, crowd marshals and a control desk on site
Full photo and video crew with drone coverage

bespoke.name: Beyond This
bespoke.tagline: More than 3,500 guests, or nothing on this page fits
bespoke.description: Multi-day weddings, corporate flagships, anything with its own logistics. We will not put an automatic number on this — a coordinator builds it with you and you see every line before you agree to any of it.
